about_the_game:
The ÖBB Sgns Container Wagon Pack recreates the modern and versatile style of multimodal freight vehicles increasingly used across Europe. Each wagon is capable of accepting containers of various types and sizes. Their multimodal concept results in faster turnaround times and more flexible working arrangements for the hauliers.

The ÖBB Sgns Container Wagon Pack for Train Simulator Marketplace includes the following rail vehicles as operated by ÖBB:

  • With white containers (small)
  • With white containers (large)
  • With black containers (small)
  • With black containers (large)
  • Empty
